name: Agnija
source:
A cute and pretty girl, who live in the small town.

The old town's folks liked her for her kindness and courtesy. Men were following her in crowds, trying to gain her favor. There were even married men among them too. But she did not reciprocate them, for her heart already belonged [url=https://vndb.org/c170860]to another[/url].

[spoiler]She thought that her love was unrequited. In despair, she tried to hurt her face, but then she became obsessed with [url=https://vndb.org/c170862]HER[/url].[/spoiler]
